title: A hundred per cent pass at Presbyterian School Guneku
excerpt: The newly established Presbyterian Primary School Guneku recorded a full pass for every pupil who sat the Common Entrance Examination in the 2020/2021 academic year.
sourceNote: Community record — Mbengwi Online (Facebook group and blog), reported by Fongoh P. Ayeh. Written fresh from the reported facts and attributed; no text or photograph of theirs is reproduced. Recorded 2026-09-02.
body:
The newly established Presbyterian Primary School Guneku recorded a hundred per cent pass for every one of its pupils who sat the Common Entrance Examination in the 2020/2021 academic year.

Schools across the subdivision had begun reopening from September 2020, and roughly seven hundred pupils and students in Mbengwi completed the 2020/2021 year.

The founding year of the school is not established in the sources, which describe it in June 2021 only as newly established.
